detail.longDescription: Puppet Server RCE (CVE-2026-115731) is exploited in the wild. A signed agent cert is enough, and autosign hands those out. Fixed versions for PE, Puppet Core and OpenVox, plus how to hunt. https:// errorbudget.io/fixes/cve-2026- 115731-puppet-server-report-deserialization-rce # infosec # blueteam # devops
